name: 259. Responses configuration_update input item keeps its reasoning effort (configuration-update)
description:
Pins #8616. OpenAI's configuration_update input item changes reasoning effort mid-conversation without changing the request-level reasoning.effort, so the prompt prefix stays cacheable. Codex sends it for gpt-6-astra and gpt-6.1-sol when the user changes effort during a session.

Pre-fix the typed decode kept only the item's type, so OpenAI answered 400 "Missing required parameter: 'input[0].reasoning'.". Bedrock and Bedrock Mantle reject the item outright ("The 'configuration_update' item type is not supported with this model."), so on those routes it is dropped. The Responses->Chat fallback has no equivalent and drops it too, instead of emitting a roleless chat message.

// A request that dropped the item would also pass the checks above, so the outbound body must
// still carry it with its own effort, next to the unchanged request-level effort.
pm.test('openai native configuration_update: the item reaches the provider with effort high, request effort low', function () {
var json = {}; try { json = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { json = {}; }
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + body.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
var items = (Array.isArray(rr.input) ? rr.input : []).filter(function (i) { return i && i.type === 'configuration_update'; });
pm.expect(items.length, 'configuration_update was dropped before the provider: ' + JSON.stringify(rr.input || null).slice(0, 400)).to.equal(1);
